lede: Illinois carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.3 against -2.4, a 4.7-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Maryland +6.5 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Illinois winning 68% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is running backs, where Illinois leads Maryland by 107 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
